meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 让Claude持续照看一个待合并的代码改动(PR)时,它会反复检查评论区、审核留言和自动检查结果,发现问题就修,直到没有遗留问题才停止,并汇报结果。
howto.when: 当你说“babysit”“monitor”这类词,或要求它持续检查某个PR(代码合并请求)的评论、审核和自动检查直到可合并时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit PR #42,直到它准备合并。
say.note: 它会开始盯住这个PR的CI和评论。

say.text: 持续监控 #88 的审查和CI,可修的就去修。
say.note: 发现问题会直接修复并推送。

say.text: 盯住 PR #123,等检查都过了告诉我。
say.note: 检查通过后会汇报最新提交和结果。

howto.what_en: When asked to babysit a pull request, Claude keeps checking comments, reviews, and CI until the PR is clean. It fixes real issues, resolves stale threads, then reports evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests like "babysit", "monitor", or keep watching a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #42 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: It will poll its CI and comments.

say_en.text: Keep watching reviews and CI on #88; fix anything actionable.
say_en.note: It will fix and push when needed.

say_en.text: Keep an eye on PR #123 and tell me when all checks pass.
